The project is indirectly majority-owned by the Africa Renewable Energy Fund LP (AREF), an infrastructure fund focused on renewable energy projects in Africa, managed by Berkeley Energy.

Banco de América Central, S.A. is the third largest bank in El Salvador and is part of BAC Holding International Corp., which consolidates operations in six Central American countries and, since its foundation in Nicaragua in 1952, has grown to become one of the largest financial services groups in Central America. The bank is successful with a customer-centric product offering and client interface and pursues a dedicated sustainability strategy with a triple positive value: economic, environmental and social. Other members of BAC Holding International Corp. are also clients of DEG.

Ascent Capital Advisors India is an independent, fully partner-owned fund manager focused on India. As one of the most experienced early growth fund managers in the country, its core team has been managing private equity funds since 2000. Ascent currently manages two funds with assets under management totaling USD 487 million and has a notable investor base.

SSCML is a limited liability company and a part of the Meghna Group of Industries (MGI).

The company imports soy seeds and crude palm/soybean oil and produces soy meal (raw materials for animal feed) and edible oil. It is holding a market leading position in both segments.

Corporación CAFSA, S.A. (CAFSA), founded in 2001, is a financial services provider specializing in vehicle loans and leases for retail clients as well as micro and SME customers. As a subsidiary of one of the country’s largest car dealerships, CAFSA exclusively finances vehicles distributed by its parent company.

Georgia Global Utilities JSC (GGU) is a Georgian-based holding company that bundles operating activities related to water supply and wastewater treatment as well as electricity generation from renewable energy in Georgia. GGU provides water services to ~1.3 million people (approx. 40% of Georgian population) as the only water company in Tbilisi and surrounding cities of Rustavi, Mtskheta and Gardabani. It has an operating renewable energy generation capacity of approx. 149 MW comprising of hydro-power plants.
Fourth Partner Energy Private Ltd. established in 2010 by Saif Dhorajiwala and Vivek Subramanian, is an established and well diversified commercial and industrial renewable platform in India.

ACWA Power Riverside Solar LLC is a special purpose vehicle established with the purpose of developing, constructing and operating a 200 MW solar PV plant and a 334 MW / 500 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) in Uzbekistan. The project shareholder is ACWA Power Company, an international developer, investor, co-owner and operator of a portfolio of power generation and desalinated water production plants.

The Nature Based Carbon Fund is a global voluntary carbon credit fund that invests in nature-based carbon sequestration and avoidance projects across Africa, Asia and Latin America. Climate Asset Management is a joint venture between HSBC Asset Management and Pollination.

ACON Sunrise Investors I, L.P. is a special purpose vehicle (SPV) through which DEG invests alongside ACON Opportunities Fund V-A, L.P. in Rymel, one of Colombia’s leading power transformer manufacturers. With 45 years of experience, Rymel specializes in manufacturing low-voltage transformers for last-mile electricity distribution to households and industrial consumers.

Founded in 2016, Monkey is a Brazil-based B2B software-as-a-service (SaaS) company that connects large enterprises, MSMEs and Financial Institutions (FIs) by providing an auction-based Supply Chain Finance (SCF) online marketplace for buyers’ payables as well as sellers’ receivables.

Main operations are currently in Brazil, but the company plans to expand to other markets in the region.

Borrower of the long-term loan is TALKE Logistics Malaysia Sdn. Bhd., established in 2020 in Malaysia as part of the TALKE Group headquartered in Germany. The TALKE Group is one of the leading logistics service providers for the chemical and petrochemical industries in Germany. ALFRED TALKE GmbH & Co. KG is the largest single company and global group holding.

Zeta Banco (“ZB” previously Financiera Finexpar S.A.E.C.A.) recently transitioned from being the largest Non-Bank Financial Institution (NBFI) in Paraguay established in 1989 to achieving a banking license in 2024, with a total loan portfolio of USD 411 million as of March 2024. ZB’s core business is providing credit to SME clients across various sectors, with a particular focus on productive regions and as a bank ZB is able to service larger clients and attract current account deposits.

Established in 1924 by the founding father of the Republic of Turkey, Kemal Atatürk, Türkiye Iş Bankasi A.Ş (”Isbank”) is the oldest and largest privately owned bank and ranks fourth amongst all Turkish banks with total assets of EUR 86 billion (FY23).

Due to its size and its market share, Isbank is systemically important to the Turkish banking system, according to the list of Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIB). The bank’s operations are largely concentrated in Türkiye (96% of loans).

Isbank provides private, retail, commercial and corporate banking, capital market operations as well as international banking services. The highly diversified loan portfolio is focused on corporate and retail-loans: The sectoral diversification of the gross loan portfolio is commercial / corporates (55%), SME (22%), consumer loans (10%), housing (4%), credit cards (8%) and overdrafts (1%).

TIB Diversified Payment Rights Finance Company (“TIBDIV”) is the Special Purpose Company (SPV) established as the offshore issuer of notes under Isbank’s Diversified Payment Rights (DPR) Program. The sole purpose of the SPV is the issuance of Isbank’s DPR notes.

The Asia Climate Transition Fund (AACT), focusing on investments in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and sustainable mobility in selected markets in Asia Pacific with a focus on South East Asia, is managed by the global sustainable infrastructure investor Actis.

Banco Promerica S.A., established in 1996, is a private, mid-sized bank based in El Salvador. Its portfolio is evenly split between corporate and retail clients. The bank is a long-standing client of DEG and is part of Grupo Promerica.

IPI Group Holding Ltd. is the holding company for telecom related activities of IPT Powertech Group, Cyprus. IPT Powertech Group was incorporated in 1993 and has become a leading full-fledged energy systems integrator and complete telecom infrastructure solutions provider combining telecom services expertise with managed services proficiencies. The group employs more than 4,500 specialists across Middle East and Africa. The group has been DEG’s customer since 2019.

DALI Discount AG is a hard discount grocery store operating in the Philippines. It launched operations in February 2020 and has since opened more than 600 stores across the country. Dali’s store network is currently served by 5 distribution centers, with more under construction. The company has a strong stable of high-quality private label brands.

LAAD Americas N.V. is specialized in providing medium- and long-term loans to small and medium-sized agribusiness enterprises located in Latin America and the Caribbean. It is the main subsidiary of Latin American Agribusiness Corporation, a long-standing DEG customer, which has been successfully operating in its niche market for more than 50 years.

ALCBF is an open ended, structured debt fund established in 2012 by KfW acting as anchor investor on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). Its mission is to support the development of African capital markets by promoting the issuance of corporate bonds. The Fund focuses on tier II financial institutions in Africa and finances mostly MSME and housing portfolios. It is domiciled in Luxembourg and managed by Cygnum Capital, an experienced asset manager based in the United Kingdom.

client_name: ACWA Power UKS Green H2 LLC JV
description:
ACWA Power UKS Green H2 LLC JV, is a special purpose vehicle established with the purpose of development, design, construction, ownership, and operation of the first integrated green hydrogen and wind project in Uzbekistan that includes a ca. 20 MW electrolyzer for a 3,000 tons p.a. Green Hydrogen facility in Chirchiq city, 45 km from Tashkent and a 52 MW wind plant as expansion of existing wind project in Bukhara province in Uzbekistan

The special purpose vehicle is 80% (indirectly) owned by ACWA Power Company – Saudi Arabia and 20% by JSC UzKimyoSanoat (“UKS”). UKS is fully owned by the government of Uzbekistan.

OrPower 4 Inc. owns and operates a 150 MW geothermal power plant in the Olkaria steam field and is the largest independent power producer in the Naivasha region of Kenya. OrPower 4 is a wholly owned subsidiary of Ormat Technologies Inc., a company listed on both the New York and Tel Aviv stock exchanges.

client_name: DIC Latin American Fund IV, L.P./Canada
description:
DARBY IV is a sector-agnostic private debt/mezzanine fund managed by Darby International Capital, that will continue with the manager’s established investment strategy of pursuing a diversified portfolio of mostly secured long-term loans with equity feature or exceptionally equity to mid-sized companies located or operating in the investment countries.

Darby International Capital was founded in 2020 and commenced operations after the investment team spun off from its previous firm, Darby Overseas Investments. Darby Overseas Investments was originally founded by former U.S. Secretary of the Treasury, Nicholas F. Brady, in 1994.  While at Darby Overseas Investments, the team pioneered regional private debt/mezzanine investing in Latin America and managed deployed capital of over USD 1.17 billion across 30 portfolio companies in 10 countries.

client_name: Indorama Eleme Fertilizer and Chemicals Ltd.
description:
Indorama Eleme Fertilizer & Chemicals Limited (IEFCL) is the world’s largest single train integrated urea plant and first major fertilizer export plant of Nigeria, located in Port Harcourt.

The company currently has a production capacity of 2.8 million metric tons (MT) of nitrogenous fertilizers per  annum. The company plays a key role in supporting the agricultural sector in Nigeria by providing high quality fertilizers to local farmers. In addition to that, two thirds of IEFCL’s production is exported to Africa, Europe, North and South America.

Majority shareholder of the project is Indorama Corporation Pte. Ltd., Singapore (via several Indorama entities). Indorama Corporation belongs to Indorama Group, a key client of DEG for about 30 years.

Turnkey Lender Pte. Ltd. (Turnkey) is a FinTech start-up company with headquarters in Singapore founded in 2016 by Elena Ionenko and Dmitry Voronenko. The company offers a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution for automated loan underwriting and loan management to lenders and non-lenders in global markets. The company’s software products enable financial services providers to automate the credit-scoring of borrowers, the credit decision making as well as the subsequent loan management.

Türkiye Iş Bankasi A.Ş (Isbank) is Turkey‘s largest privately owned banks, with total assets amounting to ca. EUR 80 billion as of end 2023 it is considered systemically important to the country's banking system. Isbank's operations, which are predominantly based in Turkey span private, retail, commercial, and corporate banking, alongside capital market operations and international banking services. Its diversified loan portfolio emphasizes corporate and retail loans, with a sectoral focus that includes commercial/corporates, SMEs, consumer loans, housing, credit cards, and overdrafts.

The Courier Guy (Pty) Ltd (“TCG”) is one of South Africa’s leading courier, express and parcel businesses focusing on ‘last-mile’ logistics with an extensive network of delivery partners, kiosks, and more than 1,200 PUDO smart lockers across the country. TCG caters for e-commerce and online retailers in need of B2B, B2C and C2B logistics services, in addition to offering traditional C2C courier solutions.
CHG is a leasing company providing efficient technology solutions to companies investing in IT, industrial equipment, health care and fleet.

The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Limited (Co-op Bank) is a public limited company whose shares are listed on the Nairobi Stock Exchange. It was incorporated under the Companies Act, 2015 and licensed under the Kenyan Banking Act (Chapter 488). Primary activities of COOP and its subsidiaries are corporate and retail banking, investment and asset management services as well as insurance, consultancy and leasing in Kenya. The Co-operative Bank was founded in 1965 shortly after Kenya gained independence, by the local co-operative societies and unions (credit unions) with a prime objective of being a specialist bank for the co-operative movement in the country. In 1994, the Bank converted to become a fully-fledged commercial bank offering a broad range of financial services.

Wavemaker Pacific Partners Pte. Ltd. is a well-established independent Fund Manager operating since 2012 in South East Asia. It had raised USD 318m across four early stage focused venture funds (seed to series B) with total investments into 210+ companies.

client_name: Latin American Green Bond Fund S.A. SICAV-SIF
description: The Latin America Green Bond Fund (LAGREEN) is an open ended, structured debt fund focusing on investments in Green and Social Bonds in Latin America. It was launched in 2019 with KfW acting as anchor investor on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the European Union. LAGREEN is advised by experienced, Frankfurt am Main based asset manager Finance in Motion (FIM). As the Fund has been launched in 2019, portfolio as well as funding is still building up and it has not yet reached its target volume.

Private Joint-Stock Commercial Bank “DAVR Bank” (“DAVR Bank”) was founded and started its activities in  2001 in the city of Tashkent. The Bank operates as a universal bank providing a wide range of services to legal entities mostly micro, small and medium sized enterprises and individuals. DAVR Bank has seven branches in nearly all Uzbek regions and is serving more than 10,000 corporate and 135,000 retail customers with a staff of over 800 employees in 2023.

Damietta Alliance Container Terminals S.A.E. is a project company established to build, own and operate Container Terminal II in Damietta, Egypt. Damietta is located in the Mediterranean in proximity to the Suez canal and with direct access to the areas of Greater Cairo and Alexandria and the Nile Delta. The Terminal will be used by shipping line Hapag-Lloyd as a new transshipment hub in the region. Operation of the terminal will be conducted by terminal operators Eurogate (Germany) and sister company Contship (Italy).

SPE III is the third fund managed by SPE Capital Ltd., a private equity manager focused on investing in medium-sized companies in North Africa with a gradual expansion into Sub-Saharan markets and a trusted partner of DEG. The Manager is headquartered in Tunis.

Stanbic IBTC Bank Limited (Stanbic IBTC) is one of the leading financial institutions in Nigeria and part of the larger pan-African Standard Bank Group headquartered in South Africa. 

As a local universal bank, Stanbic IBTC offers the full range of banking, financial and related services permitted in Nigeria.
Phi Capital Growth Fund 1.6 is an India based sector agnostic private equity fund. DEG is already invested in the predecessor fund Phi Capital Trust, which was founded in 2017.

AIIF4 is an Africa focused infrastructure private equity fund managed by African Infrastructure Investment Managers (AIIM), a subsidiary of the internationally listed Old Mutual Group.

AIIM actively manages investments across Africa and has assets under management of more than USD 2 billion with a track record extending across six African infrastructure funds.

AIIM, arguably the most experienced infrastructure assed manager in Africa, manages a large number of assets in the infrastructure space across various sector like energy, transport and digital infrastructure._ _

client_name: Commercial & Industrial Solar Green Bond B.V. / The Netherlands
description: The Commercial & Industrial Solar Green Bond B.V., established in 2022, is a specialized closed-end fund managed by Social Investment Managers & Advisors (SIMA). It marks SIMA's fourth foray into the African solar sector, targeting debt investments in solar project developers and project finance within the commercial and industrial (C&I) solar domain across Africa.

Atlantic Stark belongs to Atlantic Grupa d.d. (“AGRUPA” or the “Group”). The Group was established in Croatia in 1991 and is one of the biggest producers of fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) in South-East Europe. Operations include coffee processing, production of spreads, beverages and snacks as well as pharmacy retail.

Our customer Atlantic Stark (“Stark”) was founded in 1922 and incorporated in Atlantic Grupa in 2010, through the acquisition of Droga Kolinska d.o.o., supported by DEG. Stark is one of the biggest confectionary and snacks producers in Serbia with more than 200 products on offer, operating at three sites in the country.

Tenedora CI, S.A. de C.V. (Tenedora CI) is the non-operative holding company of CIBanco, S.A., Institución de Banca Múltiple (CIBanco) a diversified mid-sized bank which represents 96% of the holding’s assets. CIBanco was established in 2008 in Mexico. CIBanco distinguishes itself in Mexico's banking sector with its FX brokerage, positioned among the top three, and its market-leading trust business and a focus on niche segments in its loan portfolio origination.

CIBanco has developed specialized green loan products, including those for low-emission vehicles and solar panels. These offerings come with financial incentives for clients who adhere to sustainability principles. With a green strategy in place for over a decade, CIBANCO positions itself as Mexico's first green bank, reflecting its commitment to environmental stewardship and sustainable financing.

Aguila Solar SpA is a project company established with the purpose of constructing and operating four small-scale photovoltaic power plants with a combined capacity of 48 MWpeak. The plants are located in the center of Chile which belongs to the countries with the highest irradiation worldwide.

The project’s majority shareholders is German Blue Elephant Energy Group which is complemented by local developer oEnergy Group as a minority shareholder. oEnergy acts as EPC and Operation and Maintenance Contractor in this transaction.

Founded in 1985, Ecobank Transnational Incorporated (ETI), Togo, is the bank holding company of Ecobank Group, representing a unique and entrenched African franchise and the continent’s most expansive (universal) banking network in 33 Sub-Saharan African countries.

Banco de la Producción S.A. (“Produbanco”) is a universal bank and the result of a merger between Produbanco and Promerica Ecuador in the year 2014.

The bank is part of the strong regional banking group Promerica with presence in seven countries of Central America: Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, and Dominican Republic, Ecuador and the Cayman Islands. It is the region’s largest network of its kind, which does not belong to an international bank.

client_name: Banco Internacional de Costa Rica S.A.
description: Banco Internacional de Costa Rica S.A. is a small, well established Panamanian universal bank. Its portfolio is largely based on corporate clients and has a large concentration towards Costa Rica and other Central American countries.

Adenia V is the fifth fund managed by Adenia Partners, founded in 2002. Adenia is a private equity firm focused on control investments in mid-cap businesses in Africa and an existing DEG partner. The Manager has an on-the-ground presence in eight key markets in Africa (Kenya, Madagascar, Ghana, Cote d’Ivoire, South Africa, Nigeria, Morocco and Mauritius). Adenia has executed over 30 investments across the four predecessor funds totaling ca. USD 400m.

Banco Davivienda is a commercial bank based in Colombia. It has subsidiaries operating in several countries of Central America. The bank’s largest shareholder is the Colombian group Grupo Bolivar. The bank has a diversified loan portfolio, financing mortgages, commercial and consumer loans.

client_name: Ashmore Andean Fund III, L.P.  / Canada
description: Ashmore Andean Fund III, L.P. is a private equity infrastructure fund managed by Ashmore Manage-ment Company (Colombia) S.A.S., a leading mid-cap infrastructure fund manager in the Andean region.

Digital East Fund (DEF), part of Earlybird Venture Capital and headquartered in Istanbul, is a leading investor in emerging markets. DEF leverages Earlybird's extensive European network, whose assets under manage-ment exceed EUR 2 billion. The fund operates across Central and Eastern Europe, Ukraine, Southeast Europe, Turkey, and the Middle East, focusing on innovative companies in these regions.

client_name: Fritz Dräxlmaier GmbH & Co. KG, Germany
description: The DRÄXLMAIER Group, founded in 1958, is a system supplier in the automotive sector with key customers being global Original Premium Equipment Manufacturers. It develops (in-house Research & Development) and manufactures electrical systems, interior systems, electrical and electronic component systems and  battery systems. Core markets are Germany, the Americas and China. The Group operates at 65 locations in over 20 countries.

Founded in 1838, Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) stands as the largest and one of the oldest banks in Mauritius. It has evolved into a significant regional player, focusing on sustainability and climate-related initiatives in recent years. MCB has established a dedicated governance structure to enhance sustainable outcomes and mainstream climate-risk analysis. This is part of its broader strategy to bolster sustainable and climate financing for various players in Mauritius and Africa, with a keen interest in growing its presence in the energy and infrastructure sectors, emphasizing responsible financing of affordable and cleaner energy solutions.

Banco Cooperativo Sicredi S.A. (“Banco Sicredi”), founded in 1996 is the first Brazilian Cooperative Bank and the central banking entity of Sistema de Crédito Cooperativo Sicredi (“Sicredi System”), a federated cooperative credit system composed of five regional regulated cooperative centers, 105 financial cooperatives with over 6 million associates in 26 Brazilian states.

Established in 2023 in Delaware, Landsberg Investments LLC is a SPV that has the sole purpose of investing in AVLA Holding Bermudas and its subsidiaries.

Established in 2008, AVLA Group is a leading provider of credit related insurance with main subsidiaries in Chile, Peru, Mexico and Brazil.

AVLA Group’s main lines of business are surety bonds, financial guarantees, trade credit as well as mortgage insurance bonds.

client_name: Vinci Capital Partners IV A, LP / Canada
description:
Vinci Capital Partners IV (VCP IV) is a sector-agnostic private equity fund managed by Vinci Partners that will continue with the manager’s established investment strategy of pursuing growth equity investments in Brazilian companies.

Vinci Partners is a leading asset manager in Brazil active in private equity, infrastructure, public equities, hedge funds, credit and real estate. The firm was established in 2009 and is a pioneer in Brazilian private equity. Vinci Partners private equity group includes Vinci Impact and Return funds and Vinci Capital Partners funds strategies.

Banco de la Produccíon, S.A., (Banpro) established in 1991, is a Nicaraguan bank that provides financial services to companies and individuals. The bank is part of the regional group Promérica Financial Corporation. It is the largest private bank in Nicaragua in terms of assets, as of year-end 2022.

DEG has been asked by Inter-American Investment Corporation (“IDB”) to participate in the financing of “Tropicalia”, a sustainable tourism project with the purpose of developing, constructing and operating a hotel resort close to Miches in the Dominican Republic. The resort will belong to the high-class segment and include 95 hotel-keys and 25 residences for sale. The project will be developed and constructed by Inversiones Costa Elocuente S.A.S., a company headquartered in the Dominican Republic and belonging to Cisneros Real Estate.

FirstRand Bank is one of the leading financial institutions in South Africa. It has three separately branded divisions in South Africa: First National Bank for retail and commercial banking, Rand Merchant Bank for corporate and investment banking, and WesBank, the largest vehicle finance provider in the country.

APIS is a fund manager focused on finance and technology companies. Since its foundation in 2014, APIS has raised approx. USD 950 mn across three funds for investments into high-growth and tech-enabled companies in Africa and South/South-East Asia. Backed by strong performance of its current funds, APIS has gained a reputation of being an innovative investor and thought leader at the intersection of finance and technology.
Unibank S.A. is a small private Panamanian bank. It was established in 2010. It is a universal bank with a principal focus on commercial loans and small and medium corporates mainly in Panama.

DEG will be investing into the Cayman-based LP “Osmanthus II Cayman Investment, L.P.” (DEG as single investor with control being delegated to the GP). The Cayman LP will own a 14.5% stake in “Osmanthus Investment Holdings Pte Ltd./Singapore” which in turn holds a 15.0% stake in BDO Network Bank.

BDO Network Bank is the largest rural bank in the Philippines. Its client operations are executed via 333 branches and 120 credit offices with the main footprint in Davao and northern Luzon, addressing rural underserved regions. Founded in 1952 in Davao and merging with other rural banks in the 1990s and early 2000s it became in 2015 a wholly owned subsidiary of BDO Unibank, rebranding it to BDOBANK Bank in 2019.

DEG will invest in MAA General Assurance Philippines Incorporated (“MAA” or “the company”) through Triple P Philippines Pte. Ltd., a SPV domiciled in Singapore. The SPV will acquire and hold the shares in MAA.

Incorporated in the Philippines in 2004, MAA is the 12th largest general insurer in the Philippines. The company distributes its auto, fire, surety, engineering, marine, and accident products through several key channels with a focus on MSMEs and retail.

Banco Solidario S.A. was established in Quito, Ecuador in 1994. It is a bank specialized in microfinance and consumer loans, serving small entrepreneurs in all sector and all regions of the country. This bank is renowned for its inclusive financial services, aiming to empower underserved communities. Its approach combines innovative banking solutions with a strong commitment to social responsibility, making it a key player in Ecuador's efforts to boost financial inclusion and reduce inequalities.

client_name: A.P. Møller Capital – Emerging Markets Infrastructure Fund II
description: The Emerging Markets Infrastructure Fund II, focusing on equity investments in the transportation and renewables infrastructure segment in selected emerging markets in Africa and Asia, is the second Fund of the Fund Manager A.P. Moller Capital (“APMC”). APMC was founded in 2017 as an independent private equity fund manager. Its first fund raised USD 1bn in 2017 and is fully invested in African infrastructure assets.

client_name: Terminal Química Puerto México, SAPI de CV (TQPM)
description: Terminal Química Puerto México (“TQPM”) is a 50/50 joint venture of Braskem Idesa and Advario. Advario is a subsidiary of German Oiltanking GmbH which belongs to Marquard & Bahls. TQPM is a new entity only focused on this project. Braskem Idesa, has a total annual polyethylene production capacity of 1,050 kton and is one of the top petrochemical production companies in Mexico. Advario brings experience in designing, building  and operating storage and logistic infrastructure for bulk liquid products, including cryogenic gases. German Oiltanking GmbH has over 50 years experience in terminal facility operations, with world-class scale storage terminals located in key global hubs. Advario owns 8 million m3 of storage capacity with a network of 13 strategically located terminals across 7 countries.

The borrower is a production facility, established in 2020 in Mexico. It is a subsidiary of the German Rosenberger group which produces standardized and customized connectivity solutions in high-frequency, high-voltage and fiber optic technologies.

Naturasol, S.A. de C.V. and Mielmex S.A. de C.V. together form Grupo Naturasol. Naturasol and Mielmex produce   and sell honey and consumer packaged goods (mainly nuts and seeds snacks) for retailers’ private labels as well as for its own brands in the Mexican market.

client_name: Banco Promerica de Costa Rica, S.A.
description: Banco Promérica de Costa Rica, S.A. (BPCR), established in 1992, is a Costa Rica-based bank, that provides financial services to individuals and companies. The bank is part of the regional group Promérica Financial Corporation. It is the fourth largest private bank in Costa Rica in terms of assets, as of year-end 2022.

client_name: L Catterton Latin America IV-B, L.P
description: L Catterton Latin America IV-B is a private equity fund managed by L Catterton Latin America Management Co. that will continue to implement the manager’s established investment strategy.

Muangthai Capital Public Company Limited (MTC) – established in 1992 – is one of the largest listed non-bank financial institution and market leader in the microfinance business in Thailand with the highest market share of vehicle title loans. MTC offers a wide range of loan products to self-employed micro and small entrepreneurs, farmers and individual customers across the country via a countrywide network of 7,200 branches.

Banga Building Materials Ltd. (Banga) was established in 2007 and is a leading manufacturer of PVC construction materials and household products in Bangladesh including melamine, stationary, switch & sockets, fan & bulbs, recycled plastics. The company is horizontally diversifying into glassware (Opal). It is currently holding market leading positions in most of its product lines. The company is a family owned company with Ahsan Khan Chowdhury owning direct and indirect majority stakes.

client_name: Silver Dragon Water Supply Group Limited
description: Silver Dragon Water Supply Group Limited (SDWSG), 100% owned by DEG’s existing client China Water Affairs Group Ltd. , is the holding company of a group of water companies in China which owns and operates services in the clean water business (city water supply, pipeline direct drinking water, connection and construction). The Group is active in 70 cities in 14 Chinese provinces, servicing more than 30 million people and operating a pipeline network of over 158,000 km.

client_name: CIFI Sustainable Infrastructure Debt Fund L.P.
description: CIFI Sustainable Infrastructure Debt Fund L.P. (“CIFI SIDF”) is a structured debt fund founded in 2023, providing long term loans to sustainable infrastructure projects in Latin America and the Caribbean. It has a special focus on renewable energy projects. The fund is managed by CIFI AM Ltd., an asset management company and subsidiary of a long-standing infrastructure financing institution and customer of DEG, CIFI S.A..
CHGMex is an asset solution provider offering efficient technology solutions to companies investing in IT, material handling equipment, industrial equipment, health care and fleet.

JSCB Uzpromstroybank (SQB) is the second largest bank in Uzbekistan and provides a comprehensive set of banking services including corporate, SME and retail lending. The bank is in the process of being transformed into a private bank supported by IFC, EBRD, and ADB.

Engie Energia Chile S.A. (EECL) is a prominent utility company in Chile, involved in the generation, transmission, and supply of electricity in the nation. EECL is a subsidiary of Engie S.A., a French multinational conglomerate recognized globally for pioneering energy solutions. Operating in Chile since 1915, EECL stands as the country's fourth-largest energy producer, boasting a 7% market share based on installed capacity. Furthermore, it is the third-largest player in the transmission sector. EECL's current installed capacity totals 2.4 GW, with 26% being attributed to renewable energy sources. Since 2018, the company is implementing a profound decarbonization plan, with an ambitious target to exit coal-based power generation by 2025 and attain carbon neutrality by 2045.

Cabo Verde Airports S.A. is a project company established in Cabo Verde with the purpose of operating, maintaining and expanding seven airports in Cabo Verde following a privatization of all airports. The project shareholders are the French airport operator Vinci Airport S.A. (70%) and ANA Aeroportos de Portugal (30%); 100% subsidiary of Vinci Airports S.A.) which belong to the internationally well recognised Vinci S.A. Group.

Established in 1996, Orient Commercial Joint Stock Bank (“OCB“) is a publicly listed private commercial bank in Vietnam. It is a universal bank offering a wide range of banking services to corporates, SME and individual clients. The bank currently operates through 149 branches and transaction offices.

Banco Bolivariano C.A. is a universal bank established in 1979 in Ecuador. The bank offers a range of financial services with a focus on corporate clients. It also provides financial services to individuals, such as consumer loans, credit cards and mortgage loans.

Openspace Ventures IV, L.P. is a Private Equity fund targeting investments in the early growth stage in consumer-linked technology sectors. The fund is Cayman domiciled and focuses on the South East Asian market. Openspace Ventures is an independent Fund Manager operating since 2014 headquartered in Singapore.

Metier Capital Growth Fund III, is a fund managed by Metier Private Equity founded in 2004. “MCGF3” is the third Capital Growth fund of Metier, focused on control/minority investments in medium-sized companies in Africa, with a focus on Southern Africa.

Lidl Srbija KD is part of the Schwarz-Group, a food retailer, founded in 1973 by Dieter Schwarz in Germany. It has been active in Serbia since 2018. Schwarz-Group is one of the biggest food retailers in the world and operates under the brands Kaufland (supermarket) and Lidl (discounter) in 27 countries in Europe as well as the USA.

client_name: Cooperativa de Ahorro y Crédito ANDE No.1, R.L.
description: Cooperativa de Ahorro y Crédito ANDE No.1, R.L. (COOPEANDE) was established in 1965 in Costa Rica as a bank-like financial cooperative focusing on credit- and saving products, primarily for employees in the educational sector. COOPEANDE offers well-adapted products within the consumer, MSME and (Social) Housing segment through a countrywide branch network

client_name: LC Healthcare SEA Fund I, L.P.
description: LC Healthcare SEA Fund I, L.P. is a private equity fund focused on investments in the healthcare sector in Southeast-Asia. The Fund will be managed by Legend Capital, one of the first PE firms in Asia founded in 2001.

TIDE Africa II LP (TIDE II) is a Venture Capital fund managed by TLcom, who has successfully raised and deployed fund TIDE Africa I across eleven investments and is looking to build on this strategy by backing successful repeat founders who innovate across the continent.

client_name: Growtheum Capital Partners SEA Fund 1 LP
description: Growtheum Capital Partners SEA Fund 1 LP (Growtheum) is a South East Asia fund managed by Growtheum Capital Partners targeting companies operating within consumer sub-sectors in the region. Fund headed by two Founding Partners Amit Kunal and Choo Koon Po. Both have mix of Investment Banking and Private Equity experiences across SEA.

Banco BAC San José, S.A. is the largest privately held bank in Costa Rica and is part of the Central American BAC Credomatic Group. Founded in Nicaragua in 1952, the BAC Credomatic brand has grown to become one of the largest financial services groups in Central America. Strategic focus is on a customer-centric perspective and the new economic, social and ecological, i.e. triple positive value strategy. BAC San José, S.A. is a long-standing client of DEG.

BUA Cement Plc (“BUA”) is Nigeria's second largest cement producer and part of BUA Group. BUA Group is one of Africa's leading manufacturing, mining, foods, and infrastructure conglomerates with diversified interests in a wide range of sectors, including but not limited to cement, sugar, flour milling, real estate, logistics, and infrastructure. Established in 1988 by Abdul Samad Rabiu, BUA Group has consistently grown over the years, establishing itself as a leading player in the Nigerian and African private sector.

client_name: Gas y Petroquimica de Occidente S.A. de C.V.
description: Gas y Petroquimica de Occidente S.A. de C.V. is a special purpose vehicle formed to build and operate an ammonia production facility in Topolobambo, Mexico. The expected ammonium production of around 770,000 tons per year will be used to produce fertilizers. The 100% shareholder/sponsor is the Swiss Proman AG, Wollerau.

client_name: ACWA Power Wind Karatau FE, LLC
description: Customer is a project company established with the purpose of developing, constructing and operating a 100 MW wind farm in Uzbekistan. The project sponsor is Acwa Power Company (Saudi Listed Joint Stock Company).
Quadria III is a targeted USD 800m healthcare specialized private equity fund investing across healthcare subsectors in developing Asia (excl. China).

Torrecom Partners LP (“Torrecom”) established in 2010. Torrecom and its subsidiaries are among the largest build-to-suit (BTS) towercos in Latin America with operating subsidiaries in Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Chile and Paraguay. Torrecom operates a tower portfolio of approx. 1,400+ sites in those countries. Torrecom is a developer, owner and operator of wireless infrastructure/telecom towers and specializes in build-to-suit towers, allowing wireless/mobile carriers to focus on providing services to its subscribers.

Established in 2014, Sky Hypermarket LLC has rapidly developed to become one of the leaders in organized retail in Mongolia. The company is a joint venture between Altai Holding LLC (Altai), a leading Mongolian company holding 90 percent of the business and Emart Inc (Emart), a large Korean retail conglomerate holding 10 percent.

It currently has 970 direct employees with an additional 130 employees indirectly dependent on the business. The local penetration rate of organized retail in Mongolia sits only at circa 17 percent (up from 5 percent in 2018). By introducing a well-established retail concept, Sky Hypermarket is able to offer high-quality goods and convenience in services at affordable prices, thus increasing food security and the quality of life.

Banco Safra S.A., established in 1957, is Brazil’s fourth largest private bank by assets and part of the well-known financial group Safra. The bank focuses on providing loans and other financial services to local corporates, including SMEs. Personal loans and vehicle financing complement the portfolio.

Avataar Venture Partners II (AVP II) is a private equity fund focused on early growth equity investments in innovative software as a service (SaaS) and tech enabled business-to-business (B2B) companies primarily located in India. The fund is managed by Avataar Venture Capital Management Ltd.

client_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank with Foreign capital (Hamkorbank)
description: JSCB with Foreign capital (Hamkorbank) is a private bank, established in 1991 in Andijan, Uzbekistan. It focuses on lending to Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Currently, Hamkorbank is the largest private bank in Uzbekistan offering universal banking services to both retail and business clients. Hamkorbank has been a client of DEG since 2015.
NXTP is based in Argentina, Brazil and Mexico and targets Seed and Series A investments in innovative technology companies all over Latin America.

Established in 2020 by three first time entrepreneurs in India, NxtWave Disruptive Technologies Pvt. Ltd is a growing online upskilling education platform with career aligned software programs for students and recent graduates primarily from lower tier colleges in India. It sells coding courses and supports students to obtain their first job in the IT sector through its own placement agents.

Unique Meghnaghat Power limited is a Special Purpose Vehicle incorporated in Bangladesh will construct, own, operate and maintain a 584MW (net) natural gas / re-gasified Liquefied Natural Gas (“R-LNG”) based combined cycle power generating plant and associated evacuation infrastructure at Meghnaghat, Narayanganj district of Bangladesh on a Build Own Operate basis.

Unique Hotel and Resorts Limited will be a major shareholder in the SPV and is the Lead Sponsor for the Project. Additional equity is contributed by Nebras Power Investment Management B.V. and Strategic Finance Ltd. GE Capital Global Energy Investments B.V, the financial services unit of the American multinational conglomerate General Electric acts as a passive shareholder in the project.

Laprophan, established in 1949, is a leading pharmaceutical company in Morocco that operates across the complete value chain comprising R&D, manufacturing, licensing/registration and distribution. Whereas Laprophan´s own products are focussed around primary care and low cost generics, the portfolio is complemented by imported products not locally produced. Laprophan is a mid-size family owned company with Farid Bennis holding the majority of the shares.

Naked Insurance established 2016, is a leading full-stack InsurTech player in South Africa offering personal-line car, home and single item insurance. Naked’s operation is based 100% on technology (pricing, underwriting, claims management are all algo-driven), which translate into better customer experience and higher operation efficiency compared to traditional insurance companies.

Incorporated in 2014, Etana is a biopharmaceutical business in Indonesia focusing on the production and sale of vaccines and biopharmaceuticals to treat metabolic, autoimmune and other major life-threatening diseases, including cancer, in the domestic Indonesian market.

With a cultivation area of more than 7,000 ha, Virú S.A. is one of the biggest agribusiness companies in Peru. Hundreds of smallholder families deliver their produce, such as white and green asparagus, artichokes, avocados and blueberries, to Virú, where they are, for example, processed into canned vegetables and exported to more than 40 countries worldwide.

WheelsEMI is a two-wheeler (2W) lifecycle services company that provides financing for new and preowned 2W as well as a range of additional solutions along the ownership lifecycle (marketplace for trading preowned 2W, leasing, insurance, servicing and spare parts management). WheelsEMI was started in Pune, India, in 2017, as an NBFC (non-banking finance company) by a team of senior veterans of the automobile and 2W (financing) industries.

BRAC Bank Limited is publicly listed private commercial bank in Bangladesh established in 2001 with higher focus on retail and SME segments than other local banks. It provides a wide range of banking services and uses mobile banking solutions through its subsidiary bKash Ltd. to reach underbanked and unbanked population. BRAC Bank serves almost 1.3m customers, mostly in rural and semi-urban parts of the country through its expansive network of around 190 branches, 700 agent banking outlets and 460 SME unit offices. BRAC Bank is among the top 15 in the country and is ranked as one of the top-10 sustainable banks in Bangladesh.

Its strategy has continued to commit toward SMEs and optimizing the mix of physical and digital channels to enhance customer access by investing in digital capabilities and expanding agent banking network in the remote parts of the country.

MC IV will be the fourth Private Equity Fund managed by Mediterrania Capital Partners Ltd. The Fund is the fourth fund managed by Mediterrania Capital Partners. The Manager is headquartered in Malta and operates offices in Egypt, Morocco, Algeria and Côte d’Ivoire and holds ca EUR 150m worth of Assets under management plus co-investments.

client_name: Vietnam Prosperity Joint Stock Commercial Bank
description: Vietnam Prosperity Joint Stock Commercial Bank was founded in 1993 as one of the first private banks in Vietnam that focuses on providing banking services and products to the private sector, especially retail and small and mid-size enterprise (SME) customers. The bank currently operates through 250 branches and transactional offices and 73 SME centers across the country. The bank currently operates through 234 branches and 81 SME centers across the country.

PAF II is the second African fund managed by the Partech Partners S.A.S. – founded in 1982, a global tech-nology venture fund manager, led by experienced ex-entrepreneurs and operators of the global tech industry, with offices in San Francisco, Paris (HQ), Berlin, Dakar and Nairobi. The platform has invested in more than 200 global portfolio companies across 4 continents and 38 countries. The fund manager currently has USD 2bn in assets under management.

Sudameris Bank S.A.E.C.A is a mid-sized universal bank in the Paraguayan banking sector, established in 1958. It provides a full range of banking services to its clients, particularly medium sized companies and corporates, but increasingly also small enterprises and retail clients. An important share of its lending activity is towards the agricultural sector, followed by services, industry and the commercial sector.

Cooperativa Nacional de Educadores (CNE) was established in 1966 in Costa Rica as a bank-like financial cooperative focusing on credit- and saving-products, primarily for employees in the education sector. CNE offers well-adapted products within the consumer (incl. education and health), MSME and Social Housing segment through a countrywide branch network.

Banco Internacional S.A. was founded in 1973 and is the 5th largest bank in Ecuador. The bank is part of the Spanish Fierro Group and focuses on providing loans and other financial services to local corporates, including SMEs. Consumer lending and mortgage loans complement its portfolio.

Lulalend started in 2014 as an online MSME lender providing working capital loans to the highly underserved MSME segment in South Africa followed by revolving credit facilities and business cash advances. Moreover is currently extending its product portfolio by offering credit cards and as well as banking services (offering transactional accounts enabling deposits and payments) and Business Financial Management enabling invoicing and Accounting & Tax services for its MSME clients, so that they can improve the management of their businesses. Thereby Lulalend is able to reduce the loan origination lead-time by cutting manual processes as well as costs and enables more time efficient funding opportunities for MSMEs.

client_name: Alterrra Africa Accelerator Fund LP, Mauritus
description: Alterra Africa Accelerator Fund LP (AAA), is a fund managed by Alterra Africa Accelerator GP founded in 2021. Alterra Capital Partners was formed through the combination of individuals from two of the most experienced managers on the continent, Carlyle Africa and Emerging Capital Partners. The combination was driven by the respective team’s longstanding working relationship, complementary investment strategies, geographic footprints, and shared vision.

Thai Credit Retail Bank (TCRB) was founded in 1970 as a real estate lender. The bank was granted a retail banking license in 2006 and is currently the only bank in Thailand operating under that particular scheme. By focusing successfully on niche segments TCRB is one of the leaders in micro-SME and microfinance, being spread all over the country.

The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Limited (COOP) is a public limited company whose shares are listed on the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE). Primary activities of COOP and its subsidiaries are corporate and retail banking, investment and asset management services as well as insurance, consultancy and leasing in Kenya. Also, the Group has activities in South Sudan. The Co-operative Bank was founded in 1965 shortly after Kenya gained independence, by the local co-operative societies and unions (credit unions) with a prime objective of being a specialist bank for the co-operative movement in the country. In 1994, the Bank converted to become a fully-fledged commercial bank offering a broad range of financial services.

Customer is a project company established with the purpose of developing, constructing and operating a 500 MW wind farm in Uzbekistan. The project shareholder is ACWA Power Company, an international developer, investor, co-owner and operator of a portfolio of power generation and desalinated water production plants.

Customer is a project company established with the purpose of developing, constructing and operating a 500 MW wind farm in Uzbekistan. The project shareholder is ACWA Power Company, an international developer, investor, co-owner and operator of a portfolio of power generation and desalinated water production plants.

client_name: Gia Lai Electricity Joint Stock Company
description: Founded in 1989, Gia Lai Electricity JSC (GEC), listed on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange since 2019 with current market cap c.a. USD 207m, is one of the largest Vietnam-based pioneer renewable independent power producers with a total portfolio of ~500MW . GEC is a company in the TTC Group and operates several renewable energy power plants combining solar, hydro, wind and decentralized rooftop energy. In addition to power plant operations, GEC provides services such as construction, repair, testing, operation management, etc. for hydropower and solar power plants.

The Africa Finance Corporation (“AFC”) is a multilateral development finance in-stitution (DFI) established by an agreement between 25 African member states, headquartered in Nigeria, but with a majority of private-sector shareholders. 
Its objective is the financing of infrastructure, industry and natural resources projects in Africa by way of loans, equity and quasi-equity as well as structured trade finance products (i.e. funded and unfunded risk participation, syndicated lending, pre-export financing, post shipment financing, etc.). This is supplement-ed by advisory services.
AFC has various strategic partnerships (e.g. IFC, AFD, KfW, West African Develop-ment Bank), e.g. to co-develop and finance infrastructure projects, to cover in-vestments in the power sector, to provide financing for climate change related projects, and to assist existing and prospective member countries.

Walton, established in 2006, is the leading integrated manufacturer and distributor of white goods like refrigerators, TV sets, air conditioners and home appliances in Bangladesh. With the largest distribution and sales network in the country, long warranty time and after sale service unique to the local market, Walton is currently holding a 72% share in refrigerators/freezers, 42% in televisions, 15% in air-conditioners, 52% in washing machines, 10% in home and 16% in electric appliances of the Bangladesh market.

MK Group consists of around 20 companies. It is a large and diversified agricultural group with most of its footprint in Serbia. Since its registration in 1995, MK Group has emerged as the second largest agribusiness in the country with a production area of 14,700 ha. MK Group’s core business activities are the production and sales of agricultural produce (i.e. grains, oil seeds, milk, sugar, meat, apples, and vegetables).
Vertex Ventures (SG) SEA V LP is a Singapore domiciled fund that targets early growth investments in inno-vative technology companies in South East Asia and India.
Exacta Asia Investment III LP (Exacta) is a South East Asia fund managed by Exacta Capital Partners III targeting small and mid-sized companies in the region.

client_name: Klingele Paper Nova Campina Ltda. (Klingele Brazil)
description: Klingele Brazil operates a paper mill in the region of Nova Campina in Brazil. The company produces paper (primarily Kraftliner and White Top Liner), which is used in the corrugating industry to produce corrugated cardboard.

The family-run, middle market group Jowat SE from Detmold, Germany, specializes in the production of high-quality industrial adhesives. Jowat offers tailored solutions for a wide range of industries, especially in the wood processing industry as well as in the paper and automotive industries. For more than 15 years Jowat has been present in the Malaysian market with its wholly-owned processing company JOWAT Manufacturing, located in Badar Enstek. With its local representation it strives for local proximity of raw material, production and customer.

Alcazar Energy Partners II is a Private Equity renewables fund in the EMECA region. The Fund is the Alcazar team’s second investment vehicle after the first one was exited in 2021. Alcazar Energy Partners was founded in 2014 by Daniel Calderon, who established Alcazar as an investment vehicle to develop and invest into solar and wind assets in select MENA countries.

Solevo is a distributor of agriculture products, life sciences and industrial chemicals. The company serves three main business areas: plant nutrition, crop protection and specialty chemicals. Solevo is headquartered in Switzerland, with operating entities in Cote d’Ivoire, Cameroon, Senegal, Ghana, Angola, Madagascar, Mali and Burkina Faso with further exports throughout Sub-Saharan Africa. Solevo is a leading distributor in its markets, having established a strong brand recognition particularly in plant nutrition.

Hayat Kimya Vietnam Company Limited is a greenfield diapers production facility just completed in the outskirts of Saigon and fully owned by the Turkish hygiene products manufacturer and existing DEG client Hayat Kimya A.S., established in 1937 and headquartered in Istanbul.

The business strategy of Hayat is to capture market shares by offering affordable branded products, like diapers, tissues and detergents in emerging markets with high growth potential. The group spans over 16 countries in eastern Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia with 21 manufacturing plants in seven countries. Its products are being sold in more than 100 countries around the world.

client_name: Horizon Capital Growth Fund IV (HCGF IV)
description: Horizon Capital is an investment company that has specialised in Ukraine since 1994. Horizon Capital and DEG have been cooperating for several years. In 2017, DEG invested in the Emerging Europe Growth Fund III (EEGF III) managed by Horizon Capital to promote Ukrainian and Moldovan SMEs.
Adenia Capital V LP, is a fund managed by Adenia Capital founded in 2002. Adenia V is the fifth fund of Adenia Capital, focused on control investments in medium-sized companies in Africa.

Access Bank (South Africa) Ltd. is a very small Tier 2 bank in South Africa, owned by Access Bank Plc from Nigeria. It operates as a private sector bank and is in a transition process to offering the same range of prod-ucts to the South African market as offered by Access in Nigeria with the ambition of becoming the largest Tier 2 bank of the country.

Banco de Machala S.A. was established in the province El Oro, Ecuador, in 1962. It is an universal bank which focuses on small and medium sized (SME) corporate clients, especially in the agri- and aquiculture sector.

KELIX bio Ltd. (“Kelix bio”) was created in 2020 by the PE investor Development Partners International LLP (DPI), EBRD and BII (former CDC) to become the consolidating group holding of the African build-and buy-platform. The platform’s strategy is to build a vertically integrated manufacturer and wholesaler of specialty generics and biosimilar drugs in fast growing segments like oncology, diabetes, autoimmune diseases, respiratory and critical care. The core of the company is an established Indian biopharma company with advanced Research and Development capacity. Acquired subsidiaries in the Egypt and Morocco enable access to the African local markets via established registration processes and distribution channels.

TBC Bank, together with its subsidiaries, is the leading universal banking group in Georgia, serving around 2.2 million customers in retail, MSME and corporate segments with around 7.000 employees. The bank was founded in 1992 in Tbilisi by Georgian entrepreneurs.

TBC Bank offers corporate, commercial, small and medium enterprise (SME), retail, agricultural and private banking services through a network of around 160 branches across Georgia.

KARTOTEC S.A. are a specialised paper producer in Paraguay, founded in 2008 as an affiliate of the German mid-size and family-owned enterprise Moritz J. WEIG GmbH & Co. KG that started their first business activities in Paraguay in the 1970s.
Together with their Paraguayan sister companies CYSA, PACSA and REDESA, KARTOTEC cover an integrated value chain from the collection and the recycling of waste paper to the production of specialised paper like plasterboard for the plasterboard and construction industries, and corrugated paper, mainly for their own corrugated converting plant in Paraguay.
The main focus is on Latin America and South Africa.

Compañía Cervecera de Nicaragua S.A. (CCN) is a Nicaraguan company incorporated in 1926. It was the first and is today the largest brewery in Nicaragua. CCN is absolute market leader with a total share (own and imported brands) of 99 %. Apart from beer it bottles water and produces juices that are being distributed by the sister company Compañía Distribuidora de Nicaragua S.A. The Company has international ISO-certifications. Through two foundations created by the group, Fundación Victoria and Instituto Tecnologico Victoria, young disadvantaged people get technical education and in many cases are also provided with jobs in local companies.

client_name: Riverwood Capital Partners Latam II L.P.
description: Riverwood Capital Partners Latam II L.P is a private equity fund managed by Riwerwood Capital Management, a leading private equity firm founded in 2008 focusing on mid-sized technology companies in the U.S. and Latin America.

First Bank of Nigeria Limited (FBN), is the commercial banking arm and main operating subsidiary of FBN Holdings PLC, the oldest and 3rd largest banking group in Nigeria by total assets with a market share of 15%. FBN which has operations in 10 countries, offers a comprehensive range of retail and corporate financial services through more than 57,000 business outlets to over 17 million customer accounts.

Tradewind has established itself as an international factoring company and provides special, tailor-made working capital solutions to exporters in DEG’s markets. The importers are located in Europe and North America for the main part. Tradewind has offices in Istanbul, Karachi, Dhaka, Shanghai, New York, Sofia, Budapest, Lima, Dubai and Brazil.

Lidl Sbrija KD is part of the Schwarz-Group, a food retailer, founded in 1973 by Dieter Schwarz in Germany. It has been active in Serbia since 2018. Schwarz-Group is one of the biggest food retailers in the world and operates under the brands Kaufland (supermarket) and Lidl (discounter) in 27 countries in Europe as well as the USA.

Ipak Yuli Bank, established in 1990 in Usbekistan, is a DEG client since 2015, focusing on small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs), medium and small corporate clients and lately also on private clients with a strong digital focus.

Banco Atlántida is the largest subsidiary of a regional financial services group with operations in Honduras, El Salvador and Nicaragua. The bank is one of the most experienced and reputable financial institutions in Hondu-ras with a track record of over 100 years. Its business model caters to all client segments but has traditionally focused on lending to corporates. Banco Atlántida has a market share of around 20 percent, and commands the largest depositor base as well as the largest multi-channel service network in the country.

Banco Promerica S.A. is a mid-sized universal bank in Guatemala. It was established in 1993 under the name of Banco Privado para el Desarrollo, S. A. (Bancasol). In 2007, Bancasol was acquired by Grupo Promerica and shortly thereafter renamed. The bank is part of the strong regional banking group Promerica and is active in seven countries of Central America (Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, and Dominican Republic), Ecuador and the Cayman Islands. It is the region’s largest network of its kind which does not belong to an international bank.

OrbiMed Asia Partners V, L.P. is an investment firm targeting companies in the healthcare industry in China and India, across the full value-chain from biopharmaceuticals, medical devices and diagnostics to healthcare services.

Calle Cantina, S.A. (“Cantina”) is a real estate company, owning, administrating and renting buildings in Costa Rica. Cantina primarily rents space to Home Improvement and Do It Yourself (HIDIY) retail store operator Ferretería EPA, S.A. (Costa Rica, “EPA”). The HIDIY business is leading the market in Costa Rica and Central America.

BizBnk Holdings Ltd. (“BIZHOLD”) is the holding company of Bizcapital Correspondente Bancario LTDA (“BIZCAPITAL”). BIZCAPITAL is a start-up fintech established in 2016.
BIZCAPITAL is an online provider for working capital loans to MSME clients in Brazil. The Company operates fully digital: The clients provide their loan application data digitally via the Company’s homepage or app, which is then automatically analyzed by BIZCAPITAL’s underwriting engine and enhanced with digital KYC procedures. The company’s digital and automated processes are cost efficient, scalable and enable a superi-or user experience with turnaround times as short as a few hours from application to disbursement. 
The shareholder structure is as follows: The founders hold together 20% of shares. The largest shareholders are five financial investors, namely the venture capital fund Monashees and the venture capital impact fund Quona Capital, the family office Chromo Ventures as well as the impact investors Oiko and DEG.

Asia Partners II L.P. is a private equity fund targeting investments in the early growth. Companies are typi-cally operating in the technology sector. The fund focuses on the South East Asian market. Asia Partners is an independent fund manager operating since 2019.

Orafti Chile S.A. produces food ingredients (prebiotic fibers: inulin and oligofructose) obtained from chicory plants and is a subsidiary of BENEO Orafti S.A. in Belgium. BENEO - a division within the German Südzucker Group - is producing and selling food ingredients from natural sources (sugar, chicory, rice and wheat), which add additional nutritional benefits to customers’ end products. The company was established in 2006 in Pemuco, Chile.
Founded in 1996, Bank of Qingdao (BQD) is a city commercial bank headquartered in Qingdao in the Shan-dong Province of China.

Founded in 1990, Naivas Limited is a major grocery retail market operating in Kenya. Naivas is operating 84 stores in more than 20 cities and towns across the country. Their portfolio is made up of large “hyperstores”, medium-sized supermarkets and smaller convenience or express stores. Naivas has expanded its footprint gradually over time, focusing on selecting strong sites rather than targeting a specific number of stores per year.

The company has undergone a significant transformation during the past five years by doubling its store footprint as well as professionalizing operations. The aggressive growth of Naivas in the past was also driven by market opportunities as competitors failed and dropped out of the market.

CHG-MERIDIAN México (CHGMex) is an asset solution provider offering technology solutions to companies investing in their IT, material handling equipment, industrial equipment, health care and vehicle fleets.

client_name: Compañía Azucarera Salvadoreña, S.A. de C.V.
description: Compañía Azucarera Salvadoreña S.A. de C.V. (“CASSA”) was founded in 1964 and is the largest sugar producer in El Salvador. CASSA as a group owns two sugar mills, which also operate cogeneration plants.

Massive Bio Inc., a health-tech startup established in 2015, helping cancer patients worldwide to find suitable clinical trials based on an AI-powered matching platform. Massive Bio’s services are free of charge for the patients and oncologists; customers are pharma companies and CROs (contract research organizations) who are willing to pay for the Company’s services given the complexity and high cost of enrolling patients to clinical trials. Massive Bio is a US-headquartered company with hard currency revenues and highly skilled R&D workforce mainly located in Istanbul, Turkey.

JSC Georgia Healthcare Group (GHG) is a healthcare provider in Georgia. It has an integrated business model and is active in five segments: clinics, hospitals, pharmacies, medical insurance, and diagnostics. The group is present all over Georgia and operates 17 hospitals, 19 community clinics, 15 polyclinics, more than 300 pharmacies, and one multi-disciplinary diagnostics laboratory (as per 30. September 2020).

client_name: Binh Duong Water Environment Joint Stock Company
description: Binh Duong Water Environment JSC, Vietnam (BIWASE”), incorporated in 2006 and listed at the HCMC stock exchange, is the main water distributor in Binh Duong, a highly industrialised province neighbouring Ho Chi Minh City (“HCMC”), employing around 1,100 people. The company’s core activities are clean water supply and distribution (60% of revenue), waste treatment and recycling (20% of revenue) and other activities (20% of revenue) including the sale of recycled waste products and O&M services in waste- water treatment. BIWASE operates eight clean water treatment locations and one waste treatment location currently serving more than 600,000 households (around 2.4 million inhabitants) and about 14.000 companies.

The project consists of the refinancing of a portfolio of 6 operating PV power plants in Egypt with a combined capacity of 300MWac via an investment into a green bond. The 6 solar plants are part of the Benban Solar Park, one of the largest solar power centers in the world with a total capacity of c. 1.8GW. Main project sponsor ist SCATEC, one of the leading energy developers in emerging markets.

client_name: Adwa Ma'an al Oula Lil Taka P.S.C.
description: Adwa Ma’an operates the 23.8 MWp Ma’an Solar PV Plant in Jordan under a 20-year post-Commercial Operation Date power purchase agreement. The plant is currently owned by China Three George South Asia Investment Limited and was part of the first round of Solar PV Tenders in Jordan in 2015.

Turnkey is a FinTech start-up company with headquarters in Singapore founded in 2016 by Elena Ionenko and Dmitry Voronenko. The company offers a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution for automated loan underwriting and loan management to lenders and non-lenders in global markets. The company’s software products enable financial services providers to automate the credit-scoring of borrowers, the credit decision making as well as the subsequent loan management.

Otto Fuchs – founded in 1910 – is a leading German but globally active company whose products set trends in the aerospace, automotive and construction industry as well as in industrial engineering.

Otto Fuchs manufactures extruded, forged and ring-rolled products of Aluminium, Magnesium, Copper, Titanium and Nickel alloys for customers who require safety, lightweight design, reliability and durability. The com-pany has close to 11,000 employees worldwide.

Inspirali was founded in 2020 as spin-off from Anima Educação, with the purpose to consolidate the group’s medical education initiatives. Inspirali’s business model is to provide high-quality undergraduate medicine courses across Brazil (south, southeast and northeast regions) as well as continued education programs throughout the physicians’ lifelong learning journey. It holds currently 13 medical schools which comprises 1,692 seats and more than 10,000 students. It is the second largest medicine education player in the country. DEG will invest in an investment vehicle managed by DNA Capital, which will hold 25% of Inspirali.

The Indian recycling company Polygenta Technologies Ltd. (Polygenta), a subsidiary of perPETual Technologies GmbH, uses a breakthrough chemical recycling process introduced by perPETual Technologies GmbH. Polygenta manufactures rPET chips and sustainable textile filament yarns for the textile industry using post-consumer PET bottles as feedstock. Its customers include several well-known international global fashion and sportswear brands. Growing awareness of sustainability issues is fuelling demand for products made from recycled materials.

FirstRand Bank began its operations in 1998 and is one of the largest banks in Africa.
The bank provides a comprehensive range of retail, commercial, corporate and investment banking services in South Africa and offers niche products in certain international markets.
FRB is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the largest African banking group by market capitalization FirstRand Limited, which is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) and the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSX).

Finanzauto S.A. provides financing to retail and commercial (micro and SME) clients for the purchase of vehicles. The company was founded in 1970 and is one of the largest non-bank financial institutions in its segment in Colombia.

Axian Telecom Ltd. (AXIAN) is an African multi-country telecom group which is active in three business seg-ments: mobile network operators, digital infrastructure and digital services (e.g. mobile payment). It owns ma-jority and minority stakes in mobile network operators in several African countries such as Madagascar, Sene-gal, Togo, and Tanzania.

Hacienda Ojo de Agua S.A. (HODA) is a pineapple cultivator in Costa Rica. The family business, based in San José, was established in 1951 and farms pineapples at two locations in Costa Rica. The fruit is primarily exported to the USA and Europe. It is largely sold as fresh fruit or processed into juice or dried fruit. DEG already financed the acquisition of the company’s second plantation back in 2012.
Established in 2014, Zuoli Kechuang Micro-finance Company is a micro-credit company serving SMEs in Huzhou and Hangzhou city prefectures of China’s Zhejiang province.

client_name: Crescera Growth Capital Fund V-A, L.P.
description:
Crescera Growth Capital Fund V-A, L.P. (Crescera) is a private equity fund managed by Crescera Asset Man-agement Ltda.
Crescera Asset Management Ltda. is a Brazil leading private equity firm with preference on specialty retail, education- and healthcare sectors.

Banco Consorcio is a mid-sized commercial bank in Chile. It is owned by Consorcio Financiero S.A., a leading financial group in Chile that has a strong presence in the country’s insurance market. Banco Consorcio focuses on activities with commercial clients and in housing finance.

The ArmPower CJSC  (“ArmPower”) project involves the development, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of a 254MW combined cycle gas turbine (“CCGT”) power plant close to Yerevan, Armenia with an annual output of up to 2,000 GWh, under a Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (“BOOT”) scheme. The Project is critical to the Armenian power sector as it replaces a degenerated, existing CCGT plant with low efficiency.

The project shareholders are Renco, Italy (60%) and Siemens, Germany (40%).
Ashmore Andean Fund III, L.P. is a Private Equity infrastructure fund managed by Ashmore Management Company (Colombia) S.A.S., a leading mid-cap infrastructure fund manager in the Andean region.

Tanner Servicios Financieros S.A. (Tanner) is the largest non-banking financial institution (NBFI) in Chile. It was founded in 1993 initially offering only factoring. Today Tanner provides solutions for SMEs also trough leasing and corporate loans. Furthermore it has a car loan segment. Tanner operates only in Chile.

client_name: Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank
description:
Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank (TPBANK) was established in 2008 and its shares are traded on the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange since 2018. TPBANK is a fast growing mid-tier commercial bank and one of the leading digital banks in Vietnam. 
The Bank provides a wide range of products and services to retail, SME and corporate clients throughout 94 branches and transaction offices, and nearly 400 automated LiveBank points across Vietnam. The current main shareholders comprise SBI Ven Holdings (Japan), DOJI Gold and Gems Group, FPT Corporation, PYN Elite Fund (Finland), IFC (World Bank group) and Vietnam National Reinsurance Corporation.

client_name: Convergence Partners Digital Infrastracture Fund L.P.
description: Convergence Partners Digital Infrastracture Fund L.P. (‘’CPDIF’’) is the third Fund raised and managed by Convergence Part-ners, with first closing achieved in July 2021.  The Fund’s investment objective is to generate long term capital appreciation through investment in equity, quasi-equity and equity-related investments of between 10 USDm to 30 USDm

Terabank is a mid-sized bank in Georgia, providing financial services to retail, SME and corporate clients. The bank was established in 2007, and operates since 2016 under the name Terabank.
Terabank specializes in financing small and medium-sized enterprises. It operates through a network of 27 branches across Georgia.

Borrower of the long-term loan is TALKE Logistics Malaysia Sdn. Bhd., established in 2020 in Malaysia as part of the TALKE Group headquartered in Germany. The TALKE Group is one of the leading logistics service providers for the chemical and petrochemical industries in Germany. Alfred Talke GmbH & Co. KG is the largest single company and global group holding.

client_name: Quona Accion Inclusion Fund III, L.P.
description: Quona Accion Inclusion Fund III is an early stage venture capital growth Fin- and InsurTech Fund on a global scale. The manager is Quona Capital Management Ltd.. It is the manager's third fund after two predecessor funds with largely the same strategy.

VIG IV is a private equity fund that has been operating in Vietnam since 2008. VI Group is one of Vietnam’s most established PE firms. The fund manager started with a consumer goods and services growth strategy with an increasing portfolio share in tech-enabled businesses backed by the Founding Partner’s entrepreneurial expertise and track record in tech.

EVG Fund II L.P. (EV Growth) is a Private Equity fund targeting investments in the early growth stage. Companies are typically operating in the technology sector. The fund is Cayman Islands domiciled and fo-cuses on the South East Asian market. EV Growth has a large partner network in the SEA region, esp. in Indonesia, and has invested in several companies since the first close of the first growth-focused fund in April 2018.

Polaris Energy Nicaragua S.A. (Pensa), is owner and operator of a geothermal plant with a current net capacity utilization of 55MW that has been operational since 2016.
Sole project shareholder indirectly is Polaris Infrastructure Inc., a Canadian-based and publicly traded company engaged in the acquisition, development and operation of renewable energy projects in Latin America.

Balwin Properties is South Africa’s largest residential property developer. The company was established in 1996 by Stephen Brookes. 
Balwin Properties designs, builds and sells, secure, affordable and high-quality green certified residential apartments throughout South Africa. The company places a lot of emphasis on green initiatives within its developments and introduced the first “green mortgage bond” in South Africa in collaboration with ABSA bank affording clients a discount on their interest rate. In addition, the Company focuses on sustainable development and has to date, EDGE certified, approximately 16000 residential apartments. The company targets middle-income buyers in the country’s main economic hubs i.e. Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban.
Balwin Properties has been listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) since 2015.

AFMF is a USD 50.5m private equity fund investing in Cambodia, Laos and other ASEAN Frontier Markets. The fund is the successor of DEG’s investee fund CLMDF II. The fund manager Emerging Markets Investment Advisers Pte. Ltd. (“EMIA”) has been active in the region since 2010 and is one of the most experienced private equity players in this geography with established business network and local market expertise.

client_name: Ho Chi Minh City Development Joint Stock Commercial Bank
description:
HD Bank is a Vietnamese commercial bank focused on Retail and SME financing. It was established in 1989 and privatized in 2008. Since 2018 the Bank is listed on the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange. 

The bank is particularly setting its growth focus in many of the underbanked rural areas in Vietnam.

Matin Spinning Mills Ltd (MSML), established in 2002 in Sardaganj, Kashimpur, Gazipur, Dhaka, Bangladesh is a subsidiary of DBL Group. It was listed at Dhaka Stock Exchange and Chittagong Stock Exchange in 2014.
Matin Spinning Mill Ltd is one of Bangladesh’s leading spinning mills. With currently 73,200 spindles and annu-al production of 15,000 tons the Company produces combed, carted cotton, mélange, synthetic and recycled yarn from raw cotton, polyester and viscose fiber. 
The Company operates as backward linkage industry to the ready-made garment (RMG) exporting companies largely within the DBL Group and fulfils currently 50% demand of the Group. The Group exports its products mainly to Germany, Sweden and the UK.

Founded in 1998, Minsheng is a tertiary and vocational education-focused group with over 90% of its on-campus students in inland provinces of China. Minsheng’s school network comprises 10 brick-and-mortar schools and other online education platforms. Minsheng has over 93,000 on-campus students, over 1.1 million online students and accumulated over 25 million online users and 5,200 teaching and administrative staff.

Minsheng’s business model consists of proving affordable, high-quality tertiary and vocational education in China through on-campus and online channel, given that the public higher education institutions in China are not sufficient to fully tap the market potential.  Minsheng is usually present in regions underserved with public and/or good-quality private higher education providers.

NMB Bank Ltd.
